title: Chapter 1309 - 49: Lin Yuan And The Eternal Lords
content:
Chapter 1309 - 49: Lin Yuan And The Eternal Lords

Chapter 1309: Chapter 49: Lin Yuan and the Eternal Lords

Secret world.

Several Sect Masters and many sect leaders are chatting idly.

Ever since Lin Yuan confronted and repelled the Demon God, their pressure has significantly eased.

At least they no longer worry about the Source Demons or even the Demon God.

Their own strongholds will not be on the brink of collapse anytime soon.

If it weren’t for the Demonic Qi still permeating the outside world.

Several Sect Masters would even feel that the demon catastrophe might have completely passed.

"Lord Galaxy is actually not yet an Eternal Lord."

"So terrifying, the Demon God’s last attack seemed capable of easily shaking this world, yet it was easily blocked by Lord Galaxy."

"Indeed, if it weren’t for Lord Galaxy, even if the Demon God unleashed his full force upon this world, possessing multiple Eternal Treasures, it still couldn’t withstand for long."

Several Sect Masters and many elders of the sects remain immersed in the battle between Lin Yuan and the Demon God.

To face and withstand a Demon God comparable to an Eternal Lord without being one himself, since the creation of this world, this is a first, and likely a one-time occurrence.

"Luckily, I decided to present the Eternal Source to Lord Galaxy, otherwise, we might still be under the Demon God’s attack."

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect felt slightly proud.

"Yes, yes, yes."

The other Sect Masters immediately nodded.

Actually, among them, there were opposing views at the time; after all, giving the Eternal Source to Lin Yuan, what if he failed to block the Demon God?

This secret world might have soon faced destruction.

However, as things stand now, the decision of the Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect directly saved this secret world and even reversed the current situation between demons and cultivators.

"I’m not sure if the majestic Eternal Lords are aware of Lord Galaxy’s existence and how they will face it..."

One of the Sect Masters was quite curious.

In theory, the Eternal Lords are aloof and indifferent to lives below the thirteenth tier, whether strong or weak.

Even concerning their established Eternal Sects, they only care about the whole rather than individuals. For the Eternal Lords, as long as the Eternal Sect is not annihilated, it is acceptable.

But Lin Yuan?

With the strength Lin Yuan has shown, even the Eternal Lords cannot ignore him.

"These are matters for the majestic Eternal Lords..."

Another Sect Master shook his head, about to continue speaking.

At this moment——

Buzz～～～In the secret world, multiple Eternal Treasures seemed to sense something, vibrating together as the aura of eternity quickly spread.

"This?"

Several Sect Masters appeared shocked.

The Eternal Treasures are left by the Eternal Lords, and their true owners are the Eternal Lords, with the Sect Masters only utilizing them through the Lords’ methods.

Now, several Eternal Treasures have spontaneously revived, sensing traces of their true owners’ presence.

This means.

The Eternal Lords, who disappeared after the great shift of heaven and earth, have reappeared in this world.

"The Eternal Lords, the great Eternal Lords have returned?"

Some sect leaders were moved to tears, while several Sect Masters were equally excited.

Many elder disciples born after the great change of heaven and earth have never truly seen their own Eternal Lords.

A moment later.

The secret world remains the same.

Several Eternal Treasures slowly calmed down.

This left several Sect Masters and sect leaders puzzled.

Where are the great Eternal Lords?

If they have returned, why not enter the secret world?

This secret world was created jointly by the Eternal Lords, so should they return, they would definitely first come back here.

"Perhaps... the great Eternal Lords have gone to attend to more important matters..."

The Sect Master of the Eternal Infinite Sect pondered aloud, already having a hunch that the appearance of the Eternal Lords is related to the battle between Lin Yuan and the Demon God.

It is quite possible that their return this time is simply to see Lord Galaxy?

...

Lin Yuan stared at the thirteen towering figures standing not far away, with auras not very strong, likely mere consciousness embodiments.

But Lin Yuan immediately realized their identities, especially since the leading figure smiled, claiming to be ’Infinite’.

The thirteen Eternal Lords of the Fang Yuan World... Lin Yuan’s expression turned slightly solemn, for these are thirteen time beings.

While Lin Yuan’s current confrontational strength indeed matches that of a time being, the strongest aspect of a time being is not their combat power, but their ability to make choices regarding the future.

In terms of foreseeing future timelines, Lin Yuan is still far inferior to a genuine time being.

"Wu Shan greets the young friend."

"Black Space greets the young friend."

...

As the Master of Infinite spoke, the remaining twelve Eternal Lords also greeted with smiles in turn.

"Greetings to the esteemed Eternal Lords."

Lin Yuan promptly replied.

After comprehending the legacy left by the Lord of Heaven Light, Lin Yuan speculated that the disappearance of the thirteen Eternal Lords of this Fang Yuan World was likely to restrain the most powerful light form of the Lord of Heaven Light.

Without these thirteen Eternal Lords, this source world would have long been eroded; Lin Yuan would have been immediately contaminated upon arrival.

"If not for the young friend, the secret world we left behind would likely not have lasted much longer." The Master of Infinite smiled as he looked at Lin Yuan.

"It was also because of me that the Demon God got enraged." Lin Yuan shook his head.

This is the truth as well; to the Demon God, if not for discovering that a large number of Source Demons were hunted by Lin Yuan, he might not have attacked the secret world and instead focused on suppressing the source world consciousness.

"It’s all the same." The Master of Black Space shook his head, "Even if the young friend did not hunt the Source Demons, that Demon God would eventually target the secret world. It was just a matter of time."
